proposed_comments.title: Ignore inactive retained mappings in duplicate validation
proposed_comments.body:
### Ignore inactive retained mappings in duplicate validation

**Severity:** `high`

This edit-mode duplicate count still scans inactive rows retained for other profiles. With `editingId` present, one inactive match exceeds the zero tolerance and blocks an edit that save-time validation would accept. Filter to active entries before excluding the edited row.

```suggestion
            int matches = SettingsManager.EditorSettings.ShortcutSettingsDictionary
                .Where(kvp => kvp.Value.IsActive)
                .Where(kvp => editingId == null || kvp.Key != editingId)
```

proposed_comments.body: The implementation deliberately keeps the same trigger/scope conflicting regardless of `Always` versus `Alone`, which is safer for the current engine behavior.
